sites.name: M/V HONDIUS
sites.desc: Dutch-flagged polar expedition vessel departed Cape Verde 06 May, now sailing northwest toward Port of Granadilla, Tenerife; expected arrival 10 May. Spanish authorities have a narrow weather window Sunday–Monday for evacuation. Three specialist doctors aboard; 147 passengers/crew from 23 nationalities in cabin isolation, all currently asymptomatic. One body still on board.

sites.name: USHUAIA
sites.desc: Suspected source. Index case (70-year-old Dutch man) and wife took 4-month birdwatching road trip (27 Nov 2025–01 Apr 2026) through Argentina, Chile, Uruguay — possibly exposed at a Ushuaia landfill. Malbrán Institute team mobilizing to investigate rodent reservoir along route.

sites.name: SAINT HELENA
sites.desc: ~30–40 passengers disembarked 24 Apr before outbreak confirmed; 7 Britons among them. Index case body removed here; his wife (Case 2, PCR-confirmed) collapsed en route to Johannesburg. All St Helena disembarkees have been contact-traced by UKHSA. Four Tristan da Cunha islanders also hitched transport to St Helena via Hondius.

sites.name: JOHANNESBURG
sites.desc: Case 2 (Dutch widow, PCR-confirmed) died on arrival 26 Apr. Case 3 (British national, PCR-confirmed) hospitalized in ICU after medevac from Ascension Island. SA NICD leading contact tracing of 82 passengers + 6 crew on 25 Apr Airlink St Helena–Johannesburg flight; 60+ contacts identified and being monitored.

sites.name: AMSTERDAM
sites.desc: Two PCR-confirmed patients treated in Netherlands — one at Radboud University Medical Centre (arrived 07 May medevac), one earlier evacuation. One Dutch death (index case, husband) occurred on ship. KLM flight attendant who treated deceased Dutch woman tested NEGATIVE 08 May. GGD Kemmeerland monitoring all KL592 passengers.

sites.name: LONDON
sites.desc: UKHSA confirmed 2 British nationals have hantavirus (one hospitalized Netherlands, one in South Africa). Two UK nationals who independently returned home are self-isolating; additional close contacts also isolating. All returning British nationals ordered 45-day isolation. FCDO operating consular support across multiple countries.

sites.name: PARIS
sites.desc: Eight French nationals identified as close contacts of confirmed case on 25 Apr St Helena–Johannesburg Airlink flight. One reporting mild symptoms, isolated pending lab results. French health ministry coordinating diagnostics and quarantine measures.

sites.name: ZURICH
sites.desc: PCR-confirmed male passenger treated at University Hospital Zurich; left Hondius early, self-presented after symptom onset. Wife (also on trip) asymptomatic and isolating. Swiss authorities conducting additional contact tracing.

sites.name: BERLIN
sites.desc: Third death: German woman died on board 02 May (fever/pneumonia onset 28 Apr). Cause of death under investigation — treated as suspected hantavirus. Evacuated patients being treated in Netherlands include at least one German national. RKI contact tracing active.

sites.name: ALICANTE
sites.desc: NEW 08 MAY: 32-year-old woman hospitalized in negative-pressure isolation with cough and general malaise. Was seated two rows behind confirmed hantavirus case on St Helena–Johannesburg flight; contact was brief. PCR results expected within 24–48 hours. Valencia Regional Health coordinating tracing.

sites.name: TENERIFE
sites.desc: Designated disembarkation point for M/V Hondius, expected 10 May. Spain approved docking despite Canary Islands president's objections. Evacuation window Sunday–Monday only; 14 Spanish passengers to go to Hospital Central de la Defensa Gómez Ulla (Madrid) military isolation; other nationals repatriated via charter flights. WHO/CDC/UKHSA teams pre-positioned.

sites.name: TRISTAN DA CUNHA
sites.desc: NEW 08 MAY: Suspected hantavirus case in a local islander — Hondius docked here 13–15 Apr. UK minister confirmed patient is hospitalized on the island; spouse isolating. UKHSA investigating; 4 islanders also traveled via Hondius to St Helena.

sites.name: SINGAPORE
sites.desc: Two male residents (aged 67 and 65) isolated in government facility; both disembarked Hondius early and were on 25 Apr St Helena–Johannesburg flight with confirmed case. One presenting mild rhinorrhea, second asymptomatic. Test results pending. CDA: public risk in Singapore low.

sites.name: ONTARIO
sites.desc: Two Ontario residents self-isolating: two Hondius passengers who returned home. 4 Canadians remain aboard vessel. PHAC coordinating monitoring.

sites.name: QUEBEC
sites.desc: One Quebec resident self-isolating — not a Hondius passenger but shared homebound flight with two Canadians from the vessel. Asymptomatic; PHAC monitoring active.

sites.name: ARIZONA
sites.desc: ADHS monitoring one returning passenger. Asymptomatic. CDC Level-3 response activated; US passengers still aboard to be repatriated via charter to Nebraska National Quarantine Unit.

sites.name: CALIFORNIA
sites.desc: CDPH monitoring returning passenger(s). Asymptomatic. Daily check-ins protocol active. 17 Americans still aboard ship expected to transit through Tenerife to Nebraska quarantine.

sites.name: GEORGIA
sites.desc: Georgia DPH confirmed monitoring TWO residents who returned from Hondius (updated from 1). Both asymptomatic as of 08 May.

sites.name: TEXAS
sites.desc: Texas DSHS monitoring two returning passengers. Asymptomatic.

sites.name: VIRGINIA
sites.desc: VDH monitoring returning passenger. Asymptomatic.

sites.name: NEW JERSEY
sites.desc: NEW 08 MAY: NJ health authorities monitoring two individuals potentially exposed to a Hondius passenger after disembarkation. Neither is experiencing symptoms.

sites.name: NEBRASKA
sites.desc: NEW 08 MAY: Nebraska Biocontainment Unit and National Quarantine Unit at UNMC activated and staffed. CDC teams dispatched to receive 17 American Hondius passengers via State Dept charter flight from Tenerife. Quarantine protocol pending ship arrival Sunday.
